## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and its public API is intentionally small.
- [ ] Tests cover behavior at the appropriate specification, browser, Storybook, or visual layer.
- [ ] Accessibility semantics and manual-review needs are documented.
- [ ] API docs, usage examples, and generated documentation are current, or not applicable.
- [ ] Visual baselines were reviewed, or the change has no visual impact.
- [ ] Package exports, consumer contracts, and performance budgets pass, or are not affected.
- [ ] A Changeset describes the user-visible impact, or the omission is explained above.
- [ ] No generated build output, credentials, personal data, or unrelated changes are included.
